greeting: High Scholar Vael on comms. Stage 2: The Archives Awaken. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Echoes of the Past. Objective drift gets teams buried.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Complete the Trial of Wisdom.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Complete the Trial of Wisdom; Solve the Progenitor riddles; Unlock the Sealed Chamber. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Access the sealed Progenitor Archives. Immediate move: Complete the Trial of Wisdom.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: The Archives Awaken. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Truth of Creation.
rumor: Farmhands heard thunder reciting names of forgotten routes.
People keep repeating one clue from The Archives Awaken: 'Unlock the Sealed Chamber'.
The walls keep whispering patch notes. I only trust the ones with timestamps.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn upland winds are gentle enough for long-range scouting.
dialog.time_noon: Noon crosswinds can throw gliders and arrows alike. Brace for drift.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk over the cliffs creates blind pockets. Sweep before advancing.
dialog.time_night: Night uplands favor sentries and snipers. Move with cover rhythm.

party_reactions.kade: High Scholar Vael sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for High Scholar Vael accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: High Scholar Vael talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
